note: Review decisions for tracker / scan_mentions candidates that are NOT catalog entries. decision: rejected | deferred (with until) | added (exists under another catalog id). The tracker drops these rows (by name or url).

decisions.name: AMOS-MM challenge design document
decisions.reason: challenge design PDF, not data; dataset is catalog id amos-mm

decisions.name: M&Ms challenge description
decisions.reason: challenge description PDF, not data; dataset is catalog id mnms

decisions.name: idc-index-data
decisions.reason: IDC metadata index for tooling, not an image dataset (IDC is catalog id nci-idc)

decisions.name: jsrt-database (TCIA)
decisions.reason: URL does not exist (404); JSRT is catalog id jsrt

decisions.name: M3D-VQA
decisions.reason: QA CSVs only; its images (M3D-Cap, Radiopaedia-derived) were taken down by DMCA on 2025-03-12, so it is not usable

decisions.name: BreastMammo
decisions.reason: catalog id breastmammo-densemammo (auto-added): Official NUBagciLab GitHub README links two public OSF projects (n4yr2, 4azcr) holding new mammography datasets in DICOM and 16-bit PNG with density and benign/malignant labels; neither dataset is in the catalog.

decisions.name: rad-halo
decisions.reason: Rad-Halo is a text-only benchmark of sentence-level hallucination/omission labels on MIMIC-IV-Note radiology reports, with no image data; the repository itself holds only code, and the PhysioNet release is still under review.

decisions.name: AFIDs-Lite
decisions.reason: same as catalog id medvision: AFIDs-Lite is a preprocessed re-upload of AFIDs by the MedVision authors, whose README says its annotations and benchmark configs live in the catalogued MedVision dataset; the official AFIDs release (GitHub afids-data / OpenNeuro ds004470+ds004471) would need its own entry from official evidence.

decisions.name: ClinSeek-Bench
decisions.reason: The repository releases only question and label metadata for an EHR agent benchmark: 1,800 text-only EHR questions plus 989 EHR+CXR questions resampled from EHRXQA and MedMod. It contains no images and adds no new radiology labels on a catalog image dataset.

decisions.name: COVIDx CXR-4
decisions.reason: same as catalog id covidx-cxr: The Kaggle page andyczhao/covidx-cxr2 is the COVIDx CXR-4 release from the COVID-Net Open Source Initiative, which is a version of the catalog's COVIDx CXR entry.

decisions.name: FLARE-AutoMSC
decisions.reason: Official FLARE-MedFM Hugging Face repo, but it is gated, has no README and no licence, and is tagged modality:document, so the content and terms cannot be verified.

decisions.name: GMAI-VL-5.5M
decisions.reason: catalog id gmai-vl-5-5m (auto-added): The official General-Medical-AI Hugging Face repo, which is ungated, releases the GMAI-VL-5.5M multimodal medical VQA/caption corpus (AAAI 2026, arXiv 2411.14522) with redistributable images; it is not in the catalog, where only the separate GMAI-MMBench benchmark appears.

decisions.name: MetricEval-BodyCT
decisions.reason: The Hugging Face tags show only tabular/text modality: expert rankings of generated CT reports for metric meta-evaluation, with no image data.

decisions.name: MR-RATE-atlas
decisions.reason: same as catalog id mr-rate: The dataset card states that MR-RATE-atlas is part of the MR-RATE dataset release and holds atlas-registered versions of the MR-RATE volumes; MR-RATE is already catalogued as mr-rate.

decisions.name: MR-RATE-coreg
decisions.reason: same as catalog id mr-rate: The page states MR-RATE-coreg is part of the MR-RATE dataset release, offering co-registered versions of the same studies, and MR-RATE is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: MR-RATE-nvseg-ctmr
decisions.reason: same as catalog id mr-rate: The dataset card says this repository holds model-predicted NV-Segment-CTMR segmentations that are part of the MR-RATE release, which the catalog already lists as mr-rate (Forithmus/MR-RATE).

decisions.name: MSD-Lite
decisions.reason: same as catalog id msd-suite: The README states this is a preprocessed redistribution (RAS+ reorientation, channel split) of the Medical Segmentation Decathlon labelled training cases, which the catalog already lists as msd-suite.

decisions.name: MSWAL-Lite
decisions.reason: This is a third-party preprocessed re-upload of MSWAL (official at github.com/haochen-MBZUAI/MSWAL- and HF zhaodongwu/MSWAL), and the original MSWAL dataset is not in the catalog; it should be added from its official source instead.

decisions.name: Multimodal_Lung_Cancer_Dataset-CT-Mask-Clinical
decisions.reason: Hugging Face record has a licence and gated access but no README, so provenance, size, labels and source of the CT/masks cannot be verified (possibly a re-upload of TCIA lung data).

decisions.name: OmniMedVQA-V2
decisions.reason: same as catalog id omnimedvqa: The README says this is a restructured re-upload of foreverbeliever/OmniMedVQA images that uses Med-R1 splits, and that upstream release is already in the catalog as omnimedvqa.

decisions.name: PDDCA-Lite
decisions.reason: This is a third-party preprocessed re-upload (Lite) of PDDCA v1.4.1, and the original PDDCA dataset (imagenglab.com, from TCIA Head-Neck Cetuximab) is not in the catalog; PDDCA itself should be added from its official page instead.

decisions.name: Project-Imaging-X
decisions.reason: The Hugging Face repo is a survey and index of more than 1,000 third-party datasets (README tables of links, size n<1K, imagefolder of assets) and contains no imaging data of its own.

decisions.name: RAM-H1200-v1
decisions.reason: catalog id ram-h1200 (auto-added): The official Hugging Face card from the RAM-W600 authors describes RAM-H1200, a new gated CC BY-NC-SA full-hand radiograph rheumatoid arthritis dataset with segmentation and SvdH scores, distinct from the catalog's wrist-only RAM-W600.

decisions.name: ReXInTheWild
decisions.reason: The README describes a VQA benchmark of ordinary-camera medical photographs taken from PubMed Central figures, not radiology images (CT/MRI/PET/X-ray), so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: SwissPancreas
decisions.reason: catalog id swisspancreas (auto-added): The official AbdomenAtlas (JHU) Hugging Face record releases 684 Basel CT-report pairs (445 with pancreatic tumours) under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, ungated, and no catalog entry covers this test set.

decisions.name: UL_Brain
decisions.reason: Gated Hugging Face upload tagged brain MRI segmentation with no README, so there is no description, size, provenance or official source to confirm scope or fill the entry.

decisions.name: UniMedVL-5M
decisions.reason: The HF record for this multimodal medical VLM corpus has no README, an 'other' licence and gated access, so modality scope, image provenance and terms cannot be verified.

decisions.name: visible-human-3d-models
decisions.reason: catalog id visible-human-3d-models (auto-added): The official BoneHub (University of Twente) Hugging Face release provides whole-body Visible Human CT volumes in NIfTI with 142/143 per-bone segmentations under CC BY 4.0, and neither it nor the Visible Human source is in the catalog.

decisions.name: vsd-feet-seg
decisions.reason: same as catalog id vsd-lower-extremities-seg: The README says this is a foot-cropped repackaging of the same 30 VSDFullBody CT subjects and Fischer bone meshes already catalogued by the same publisher as vsd-lower-extremities-seg (case numbers match), only with finer per-bone foot labels.

decisions.name: A091105
decisions.reason: The TCIA A091105 desmoid-tumor MR/CT collection is not in the catalog, but its page lists image access as 'Unavailable' under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy, with downloads awaiting re-enabling, so current access terms are unclear.

decisions.name: AAPM-RT-MAC
decisions.reason: catalog id aapm-rt-mac (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 55 head-and-neck T2-weighted MRI cases in DICOM with RTSTRUCT organ-at-risk contours, and no AAPM-RT-MAC entry exists in the catalog.

decisions.name: ACNS0332
decisions.reason: The TCIA page lists the ACNS0332 MR/CT DICOM images as 'Unavailable' under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy, with downloads suspended pending a new access route, so current access terms cannot be determined.

decisions.name: ACRIN-Contralateral-Breast-MR
decisions.reason: catalog id acrin-contralateral-breast-mr (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 984 patients of ACRIN 6667 breast MRI and CR in DICOM under CC BY 4.0, and no ACRIN 6667 entry exists in the catalog.

decisions.name: ACRIN-DSC-MR-BRAIN
decisions.reason: catalog id acrin-dsc-mr-brain (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page describes ACRIN 6677/RTOG 0625 brain MRI and CT for 123 recurrent glioblastoma patients in DICOM, and no catalog entry covers ACRIN-DSC-MR-Brain.

decisions.name: AHEP0731
decisions.reason: catalog id ahep0731 (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page documents a 190-subject pediatric hepatoblastoma DICOM imaging collection (CT, MR, PET, XA, US) from COG trial AHEP0731 under NIH controlled access, and it is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: AHOD0831
decisions.reason: AHOD0831 is an in-scope TCIA pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma PET/CT/MR collection not in the catalog, but its page lists image access as 'Unavailable' under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy, with re-enabled access only promised for the future.

decisions.name: ARAR0331
decisions.reason: ARAR0331 is an in-scope TCIA pediatric nasopharyngeal cancer CT/MR/PET collection that is not in the catalog, but the page lists its access points as 'Unavailable' under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy, with re-enabling only promised later, so current access terms are unclear.

decisions.name: AREN0532
decisions.reason: The official TCIA page lists AREN0532 (pediatric Wilms tumor CT/MR/PET DICOM) with access 'Unavailable' because NIH Controlled Data Access Policy changes ended downloads pending a new access route, so current openness and access terms are unclear.

decisions.name: AREN0533
decisions.reason: The TCIA collection (294 pediatric Wilms tumour patients, CT/MR/CR/US DICOM) is not in the catalog, but the page lists access as 'Unavailable' under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy and gives no current way to obtain the images.

decisions.name: AREN0534
decisions.reason: The TCIA AREN0534 Wilms tumor collection (CT/MR/PT, 239 subjects) is in scope and not yet in the catalog, but its page lists the images as 'Unavailable' under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy, with downloads disabled pending a new access route, so access terms are unclear.

decisions.name: AURORA-METASTATIC-BREAST-MULTIOMICS
decisions.reason: The TCIA collection contains only histopathology whole-slide images (H&E SVS, immunofluorescence TIFF) plus clinical data, with no CT/MRI/PET/X-ray, so it is pathology and out of scope.

decisions.name: B-mode-and-CEUS-Liver
decisions.reason: The TCIA collection page lists the only image modality as US (B-mode and contrast-enhanced ultrasound DICOM), and ultrasound is out of scope.

decisions.name: BCBM-RADIOGENOMICS
decisions.reason: catalog id bcbm-radiogenomics (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 268 T1 post-contrast brain MRIs in NIfTI from 165 breast-cancer brain-metastasis patients with expert segmentations under CC BY 4.0, and no matching catalog entry exists.

decisions.name: BRAIN-TR-GAMMAKNIFE
decisions.reason: catalog id brain-tr-gammaknife (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page describes Brain-TR-GammaKnife, 47 patients with gadolinium T1 MPRAGE MRI in DICOM plus RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE and lesion recurrence labels, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: BREAST-LESIONS-USG
decisions.reason: The TCIA page describes Breast-Lesions-USG as a breast ultrasound dataset (data type US, PNG images), and ultrasound is out of scope for the catalog.

decisions.name: Breast-MRI-NACT-Pilot
decisions.reason: catalog id breast-mri-nact-pilot (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page documents 64-patient longitudinal breast DCE-MRI with DICOM SEG segmentations under CC BY 3.0, and no catalog entry covers this UCSF pilot collection.

decisions.name: C-NMC-2019
decisions.reason: The TCIA page shows C-NMC-2019 contains single-cell blood smear microscopy images (BMP) of leukemia cells, which is pathology/microscopy and not radiology imaging.

decisions.name: CALGB50303
decisions.reason: The TCIA CALGB50303 lymphoma PET/CT collection is in scope and not in the catalog, but its page lists access as 'Unavailable' under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy, with downloads disabled pending a new access route, so access terms are unclear.

decisions.name: CAPSULE-ENDOSCOPY-SB-NET
decisions.reason: The TCIA collection contains only capsule endoscopy JPG/MPG images, and endoscopy is out of scope; no CT, MRI, PET or X-ray data is released.

decisions.name: CATCH
decisions.reason: The TCIA page shows CATCH is a canine cutaneous histopathology whole-slide image dataset (SVS), which is pathology and outside the catalog's radiology scope.

decisions.name: CC-Radiomics-Phantom
decisions.reason: catalog id cc-radiomics-phantom (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page describes 17 open DICOM CT scans of the CCR radiomics phantom with RTSTRUCT contours under CC BY 3.0, and the collection is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: CC-Radiomics-Phantom-2
decisions.reason: catalog id cc-radiomics-phantom-2 (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 251 openly downloadable DICOM CT scans of the Credence Cartridge Radiomics texture phantom under CC BY 3.0, and the dataset is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: CC-Radiomics-Phantom-3
decisions.reason: catalog id cc-radiomics-phantom-3 (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page documents an openly downloadable (CC BY 3.0) CT phantom DICOM dataset scanned on 100 scanners, and it is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: CC-Tumor-Heterogeneity
decisions.reason: catalog id cc-tumor-heterogeneity (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents an open CC BY 4.0 DICOM collection (MR, PET/CT, RTSTRUCT, 23 cervical cancer patients) that is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: CODEX-IMAGING-OF-HCC
decisions.reason: TCIA collection contains only CODEX multiplexed immunofluorescence and whole-slide tissue images (TIFF) of HCC, which is pathology/microscopy with no radiology imaging, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: COVID-19-AR
decisions.reason: catalog id covid-19-ar (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 105 COVID-19 positive patients with CT, CR and DX DICOM images, clinical data and a CC BY 4.0 licence, and the catalog has no entry for it.

decisions.name: COVID-19-NY-SBU
decisions.reason: catalog id covid-19-ny-sbu (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page (DOI 10.7937/TCIA.BBAG-2923) describes a CC BY 4.0 multimodality DICOM collection from 1,384 COVID-19-positive patients with linked clinical data, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: CPTAC-AML
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-aml (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page lists CC BY 4.0 DICOM CT/US radiology (5 subjects, 4,108 images) alongside pathology slides, and CPTAC-AML is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: CPTAC-BRCA
decisions.reason: The TCIA CPTAC-BRCA collection currently contains only whole-slide pathology images (SVS, 134 subjects) and no radiology data, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: CPTAC-CM
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-cm (auto-added): The official TCIA page documents CPTAC-CM: open CT/MR/PET DICOM radiology for 18 melanoma subjects under CC BY 4.0, and it is not in the catalog (only the CCRCC, GBM and PDA CPTAC collections are).

decisions.name: CPTAC-COAD
decisions.reason: The TCIA CPTAC-COAD page lists only whole slide pathology images (SVS, 106 subjects) and no radiology data, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: CPTAC-HNSCC
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-hnscc (auto-added): The official TCIA page documents CPTAC-HNSCC, a head and neck CT/MR/PET DICOM collection that is not in the catalog (only the CCRCC, GBM and PDA CPTAC collections are listed).

decisions.name: CPTAC-LSCC
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-lscc (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents CPTAC-LSCC lung squamous cell carcinoma CT/PET DICOM data (36 subjects, CC BY 4.0), and no CPTAC-LSCC entry exists in the catalog.

decisions.name: CPTAC-LUAD
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-luad (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page documents CPTAC-LUAD (CT/PT/MR DICOM, 38 radiology subjects, CC BY 4.0), and no CPTAC-LUAD entry exists in the catalog (only CCRCC, GBM and PDA).

decisions.name: CPTAC-OV
decisions.reason: The TCIA CPTAC-OV page lists only whole slide images (SVS pathology, 102 subjects) with no radiology series, so the data is out of scope.

decisions.name: CPTAC-SAR
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-sar (auto-added): Official TCIA page documents an open CC BY 4.0 radiology DICOM collection (CT/MR/PET, 24 subjects) for CPTAC sarcomas, and no CPTAC-SAR entry exists in the catalog.

decisions.name: CPTAC-STAD
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-stad (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page lists CPTAC-STAD with CT/US DICOM radiology for 20 subjects under CC BY 4.0, and the dataset is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: CPTAC-UCEC
decisions.reason: catalog id cptac-ucec (auto-added): The official TCIA page documents CPTAC-UCEC as an open CC BY 4.0 DICOM collection (CT/MR/PET, 90 radiology subjects), and no CPTAC-UCEC entry exists in the catalog.

decisions.name: CT-IMAGES-IN-COVID-19
decisions.reason: catalog id ct-images-in-covid-19 (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 661 subjects of RT-PCR-confirmed COVID-19 unenhanced chest CTs in NIfTI under CC BY 4.0, and no catalog entry covers this collection.

decisions.name: CT-Phantom4Radiomics
decisions.reason: catalog id ct-phantom4radiomics (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page documents a CC BY 4.0 DICOM CT phantom dataset (238 series with liver/lesion SEG) that is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: CT-vs-PET-Ventilation-Imaging
decisions.reason: catalog id ct-vs-pet-ventilation-imaging (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page (DOI 10.7937/3ppx-7s22, CC BY 4.0) documents paired BHCT, 4DCT and Galligas PET ventilation DICOM scans for 20 lung cancer patients, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: CT4Harmonization-Multicentric
decisions.reason: catalog id ct4harmonization-multicentric (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page (DOI 10.7937/m0pb-bh69) describes an open CC BY 4.0 multi-centre CT phantom dataset in DICOM with liver ROI segmentations, and the catalog does not contain it.

decisions.name: CTpred-Sunitinib-panNET
decisions.reason: catalog id ctpred-sunitinib-pannet (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page documents 38 patients' pretreatment CT in DICOM (22,474 images) with clinical/outcome data under CC BY 4.0, and no catalog entry covers this collection.

decisions.name: DFCI-BCH-BWH-PEDS-HGG
decisions.reason: catalog id dfci-bch-bwh-peds-hgg (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page (DOI 10.7937/v8h6-bg25) lists 61 pediatric high-grade glioma MRI cases with T1, T1CE, T2 and FLAIR in NIfTI under CC BY 4.0, a distinct collection that is a subset of the catalogued BraTS-PEDs.

decisions.name: DLBCL-MORPHOLOGY
decisions.reason: The TCIA collection contains only H&E and immunohistochemistry pathology slide images (SVS/PNG) with clinical data and no radiology imaging, so pathology is out of scope.

decisions.name: DRO-Toolkit
decisions.reason: The TCIA page describes 32 purely synthetic, mathematically defined digital reference objects (computational phantoms with no anatomy or patients) for radiomics-pipeline standardization, so it is not a medical imaging dataset in the catalog's scope.

decisions.name: EA1141
decisions.reason: catalog id ea1141 (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 500 subjects with breast MRI, DBT/mammography and CT in DICOM under CC BY 4.0, and no catalog entry covers the EA1141 trial.

decisions.name: EAY131
decisions.reason: catalog id eay131 (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents EAY131 (NCI-MATCH screening trial): 2,813 subjects with CT/MR/PET/NM/XA DICOM under CC BY 4.0, and no catalog entry exists for it.

decisions.name: EXACT
decisions.reason: catalog id exact-anal-cancer-mri (auto-added): The official TCIA page documents ExACT, a 30-patient multiparametric pelvic MRI anal cancer collection (DICOM, 6,400 images) that is not in the catalog, though downloads are currently suspended under the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy.

decisions.name: GAMMAKNIFE-HIPPOCAMPAL
decisions.reason: catalog id gammaknife-hippocampal (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page (DOI 10.7937/Q967-X166) describes 390 Gamma Knife patients with DICOM CT/MR, RT planning data and multi-observer hippocampal contours, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: GBM-DSC-MRI-DRO
decisions.reason: catalog id gbm-dsc-mri-dro (auto-added): Official TCIA collection page documents an openly downloadable (CC BY 4.0) synthetic DSC-MRI digital reference object for glioblastoma in DICOM with ROI masks, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: HANCOCK
decisions.reason: The TCIA page lists HANCOCK's data types as whole slide images and tissue microarrays only, and states that no radiology imaging (CT, MRI, PET) is included, so it is pathology data and out of scope.

decisions.name: HE-VS-MPM
decisions.reason: The TCIA page lists only whole-slide histopathology (SVS) and multiphoton microscopy images of breast DCIS; pathology and microscopy are out of scope, and there is no radiology modality.

decisions.name: HEAD-NECK-CETUXIMAB
decisions.reason: catalog id head-neck-cetuximab (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 111 head and neck cancer patients from the RTOG 0522 trial, with DICOM PET/CT and RT structures, doses and plans. No catalog entry covers this collection.

decisions.name: HER2-TUMOR-ROIS
decisions.reason: The TCIA collection contains only H&E whole-slide pathology images (SVS) with tumor ROI annotations and no radiology imaging, so pathology is out of scope.

decisions.name: HISTOLOGYHSI-BC-RECURRENCE
decisions.reason: The TCIA collection contains only histopathology whole-slide images and microscopic hyperspectral images with clinical data, with no CT, MRI, PET or X-ray, so pathology data is out of scope.

decisions.name: HISTOLOGYHSI-GB
decisions.reason: The TCIA page describes hyperspectral microscopy images of H&E-stained histology slides (photomicrographs). This is pathology data, not CT/MRI/PET/X-ray, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: HNC-IMRT-70-33
decisions.reason: catalog id hnc-imrt-70-33 (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 211 head-and-neck cancer patients with planning CT plus RTSTRUCT, RTDOSE and RTPLAN in DICOM; no catalog entry covers this collection.

decisions.name: HNSCC-3DCT-RT
decisions.reason: catalog id hnscc-3dct-rt (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 31 HNSCC patients with longitudinal CT (pre-, mid- and post-radiotherapy), RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE and clinical data; this is a different collection from the catalog's MD Anderson 'hnscc' entry.

decisions.name: HNSCC-MIF-MIHC-COMPARISON

decisions.name: HUNGARIAN-COLORECTAL-SCREENING

decisions.name: ICDC-Glioma
decisions.reason: catalog id icdc-glioma (auto-added): The official TCIA page documents an open CC BY 4.0 collection of 650 DICOM MR series from 57 dogs with glioma; no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: Lung Phantom
decisions.reason: catalog id tcia-lung-phantom (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page shows an open (CC BY 3.0) DICOM CT scan of the FDA anthropomorphic thorax phantom, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: Lung-Fused-CT-Pathology

decisions.name: LungCT-Diagnosis
decisions.reason: catalog id lungct-diagnosis (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 61 diagnostic contrast-enhanced lung adenocarcinoma CT scans in DICOM under CC BY 3.0, and no LungCT-Diagnosis entry exists in the catalog.

decisions.reason: catalog id midi-b (auto-added): The official TCIA collection page documents 538 subjects of multi-modality DICOM (CT, MR, PT, DX, MG, CR) with synthetic PHI, answer keys and mapping files under CC BY 4.0, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: MIDRC-RICORD-1B

decisions.name: Mouse-Astrocytoma

decisions.name: Dataset of RNA-seq profiles from THP-1-derived macrophages pretreated with AZD7648 and stimulated wi

decisions.name: Dataset_BCD_mammography_images_out

decisions.name: DBCM

decisions.name: DDSM CBIS Patch

decisions.name: DDSM Dataset

decisions.name: DDSM Mammography
decisions.reason: same as catalog id cbis-ddsm: This is a personal Kaggle re-upload titled 'DDSM Mammography' of DDSM-derived mammography data, whose curated official release is already catalogued as CBIS-DDSM on TCIA; the fetched page showed only the title.

decisions.name: DDSM-mammography-positive-case
decisions.reason: This is an unofficial personal Kaggle re-upload of DDSM mammograms (likely the positive cases only), and the page shows no provenance beyond its title; the original DDSM is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: DeepStroke

decisions.name: DeepTumorVQA_2.0

decisions.name: deidentified-head-dicom-sample-10

decisions.name: dental-implant-brand-benchmark

decisions.name: dental-panoramic-xray-yolo
decisions.reason: Unofficial third-party YOLO remix combining DENTEX (already in the catalog as dentex) with OralXrays-9 images under remapped labels; it is not an official source and the CC BY-NC 4.0 relicensing conflicts with DENTEX's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

decisions.name: dental-radiology

decisions.name: dentalgemma-vqa

decisions.name: CETUS

decisions.name: GazeSearch

decisions.name: OpenBrain

decisions.name: RR-Findings

decisions.name: STRAUS

decisions.name: yolo-fracture-detection-dataset-x-ray-detection

decisions.name: dentex-panoramic

decisions.name: DET-COMPASS

decisions.name: Development of a large-scale grounded vision language dataset for chest CT analysis

decisions.name: diagnostic-scope-differential-control-radiology-v01

decisions.name: LiTS Dataset: Liver and Tumor Segmentation 256x256

decisions.name: Multi-Stage X-Ray Imaging Dataset of Phase Trapping in Porous Media
decisions.reason: The dataset contains X-ray micro-CT images of supercritical CO2-brine coreflooding in a synthetic sintered glass core (geoscience), not medical images, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: Multi-TE Diffusion MRI Dataset for Exploring Combined Diffusion-Relaxometry Methods in Microstructur
decisions.reason: catalog id multi-te-diffusion-mri-zju (auto-added): A Scientific Data descriptor documents an open multi-TE diffusion brain MRI dataset (3 healthy subjects, 10 TE sessions, raw and preprocessed) on Science Data Bank that is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: Multimodal-Chest-X-ray-dataset-for-Normal-and-Bacterial-Pneumonia-in-Africans
decisions.reason: Unofficial re-upload derived from the Coronahack Chest X-Ray Dataset (itself a repackaging of the pediatric pneumonia CXR set) with synthetic EHR added, no African provenance and an unclear 'other' licence, so it is not an official, in-scope new dataset.

decisions.name: multimodal-ct-radiology-reports
decisions.reason: catalog id perle-ai-multimodal-ct-radiology-reports (auto-added): The official Perle AI Hugging Face card describes 10 de-identified CT subjects (171 DICOM series) with paired radiologist reports under a custom DUA, and nothing like it is in the catalog.

decisions.name: multiple-sclerosis-dataset
decisions.reason: This is a commercial vendor (UniqueData/Unidata) sample: a single patient's 13 MS brain MRI studies posted as an advertisement, with the full dataset available only by purchase.

decisions.name: Musculoskeletal CT Segmentation Dataset of Lower Limbs for High-fidelity Human Digital Twin
decisions.reason: The Scientific Data descriptor describes an in-scope lower-limb CT dataset (20 healthy subjects, 44 bone and muscle structures segmented), but the fetched page gives no data repository, access terms or data licence.

decisions.name: nanog-cancer-data
decisions.reason: An independent individual's pretraining corpus, mostly literature text, omics, simulated traces and histopathology, with only some re-packaged TCIA/IDC volumes; this is an unofficial aggregation without dedicated radiology provenance rather than an original imaging dataset.

decisions.name: NCI-ISBI
decisions.reason: This is an unofficial MedOtter re-upload of the TCIA NCI-ISBI 2013 prostate zonal segmentation challenge (DOI 10.7937/K9/TCIA.2015.zF0vlOPv), which labels images from the catalogued Prostate-3T and PROSTATE-DIAGNOSIS collections; it should be added as an annotation entry only after the official TCIA

decisions.name: neuro2-neuroscience-datasets
decisions.reason: The README states this is an unofficial mirror of the Neuro2 catalog containing metadata only (names, links, counts, descriptions) with no image data; the recordings stay on their original hosts.

decisions.name: neurobench
decisions.reason: catalog id neurobench-mlinslab (auto-added): The official Hugging Face card from the Machine Learning in Neurosurgery Lab describes gated brain MRI/CT studies in NIfTI with classification, VQA and report-generation tasks under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: neuroscan-ai-dataset
decisions.reason: same as catalog id learn2reg: The README says this is a personal re-upload of the Learn2Reg lung CT training data (Zenodo 3835682), which is already in the catalog as learn2reg.

decisions.name: NIH Chest X-rays
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nih-chestxray14: Kaggle 'NIH Chest X-rays' (nih-chest-xrays/data) is the well-known Kaggle mirror of the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset already in the catalog.

decisions.name: NIH Chest X-rays Bbox version
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nih-chestxray14: The Kaggle upload is a personal re-upload of the NIH ChestX-ray14 images with their bounding-box subset, and that dataset is already in the catalog as nih-chestxray14.

decisions.name: NIH-Chest-X-ray-dataset
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nih-chestxray14: The Hugging Face card is an unofficial re-upload of NIH ChestX-ray14 (112,120 images; it links the NIH Box homepage and cites the CVPR 2017 paper), which is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: NIH-Chest-X-ray-dataset-small
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nih-chestxray14: Unofficial Hugging Face re-upload of a ~7.3k-image subset of NIH ChestX-ray14 (same 14 finding labels plus No Finding), which is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: NIH-Chest-X-ray-dataset_10k
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nih-chestxray14: Unofficial 10k-image Hugging Face re-upload of NIH ChestX-ray14 (same 15 class labels), which is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: NIH-Chest-X-ray-dataset_resized300px
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nih-chestxray14: Personal Hugging Face re-upload of NIH ChestX-ray14, resized to 300 px: same 15 label classes and the official 86,524/25,596 train/test split, and the original is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: nlst-new-lesion
decisions.reason: Gated Hugging Face repo with no README; tags suggest a text/JSON RL-agent benchmark derived from NLST chest CT, but whether it contains images or labels and how it relates to the catalogued NLST cannot be determined from the evidence.

decisions.name: NLST-New-lesion-LongCT
decisions.reason: catalog id nlst-new-lesion-longct (auto-added): The candidate is an unofficial Hugging Face mirror, but it points to an official TCIA analysis result (DOI 10.7937/eyvh-ag54) of new-lesion point annotations on NLST CT that is not yet in the catalog.

decisions.name: Nodules in Chest X-rays (JSRT)
decisions.reason: same as catalog id jsrt: Kaggle user re-upload of the JSRT chest radiograph nodule database, which is already in the catalog as 'jsrt'.

decisions.name: Non-alcohol fatty liver disease (NAFLD)
decisions.reason: This is a personal Kaggle re-upload with no stated provenance or imaging content; the page shows only a title, and it appears to be the tabular NAFLD cohort data from R's survival package rather than radiology images.

decisions.name: Nova
decisions.reason: catalog id nova-brain-mri (auto-added): The official Hugging Face page from the paper's first author describes NOVA as an open (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) brain MRI benchmark of 906 PNG slices with radiologist captions, bounding boxes and clinical histories; it is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: NSCLC-PleuralEffusion
decisions.reason: catalog id plethora (auto-added): The candidate is an unofficial Hugging Face mirror of TCIA's PleThora analysis result, an official CC BY 3.0 label set on NSCLC-Radiomics (in the catalog) that is not yet catalogued, so it is added as an annotation entry pointing at the TCIA page.

decisions.name: NucMM
decisions.reason: NucMM is a cellular-scale nuclei segmentation challenge on a zebrafish electron-microscopy volume and an ex vivo mouse micro-CT volume, which is microscopy/connectomics data rather than clinical radiology imaging.

decisions.name: NucMM-M
decisions.reason: The README describes electron microscopy volumes of mouse brain nuclei, which is not an in-scope radiology modality, and the Hugging Face repo is an unofficial re-upload of NucMM.

decisions.name: NucMM-Z
decisions.reason: NucMM-Z is a 3D electron microscopy dataset of zebrafish brain nuclei, which is non-radiology imaging and out of scope; this is also a third-party mirror.

decisions.name: NV-Raw2Insights-US
decisions.reason: The README describes a simulated ultrasound (k-Wave full synthetic aperture) channel-data dataset, and ultrasound is out of scope for the catalog.

decisions.name: OAI-Knee-MRI
decisions.reason: same as catalog id oai: A personal Hugging Face re-upload of Osteoarthritis Initiative knee MRI (no README, gated manually), whose original OAI dataset is already in the catalog as 'oai'.

decisions.name: OASIS Alzheimer's Detection
decisions.reason: same as catalog id oasis-1: The Kaggle upload by a personal user (ninadaithal/imagesoasis) is an unofficial re-upload of OASIS brain MRI slices, and OASIS is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: oasis-1-lab-processed
decisions.reason: same as catalog id oasis-1: Personal Hugging Face re-upload of OASIS-1 (416 participants, 436 sessions, WashU NRG processed data), which is already in the catalog as oasis-1.

decisions.name: Oculo
decisions.reason: The README describes Oculo as an ocular B-scan ultrasound dataset in ophthalmology, so both the ultrasound modality and the ophthalmology domain are out of scope.

decisions.name: OmniMRG-Bench
decisions.reason: The README states the release contains only text and QA annotations derived from ground-truth reports (no images), pooled across eight sources including ultrasound, so it is a report-evaluation text benchmark rather than an imaging dataset or a clean label add-on for one catalog dataset.

decisions.name: on-harmony-traveling-heads-3t
decisions.reason: This is an unofficial personal Hugging Face re-upload of ON-Harmony (OpenNeuro ds004712, Warrington et al. 2025), and the original is not in the catalog; the official OpenNeuro source should be triaged instead.

decisions.name: Open dataset of femoral cross-sectional geometry across ontogeny, including high resolution CT-deriv
decisions.reason: The Data in Brief page only returned a redirect, so there is no evidence on image content, format, host or access; the title suggests CT-derived femoral cross-sectional geometry that may be measurements or models rather than images.

decisions.name: openm3chest-npy-v2
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nlst: The README describes ~3,793 NLST chest CT volumes from IDC, converted to NPY by a personal account for MedGemma fine-tuning; NLST is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: OpenMedReason
decisions.reason: auto-entry failed validation: [openmedreason] modality must be a non-empty list

decisions.name: ORCA-3DCT
decisions.reason: The repository hosts only precomputed encoder embeddings, compressed visual tokens, model checkpoints and token-grid organ occupancy derived from CT-RATE, with no image data and no expert label set of its own.

decisions.name: oropharyngeal radiomics outcomes
decisions.reason: catalog id oropharyngeal-radiomics-outcomes (auto-added): The official TCIA analysis-result page describes 412 OPC CT scans with expert GTVp/GTVn RTSTRUCT contours and outcome data, a subset of the HNSCC collection; no catalog entry covers this analysis result.

decisions.name: PAIP 2019
decisions.reason: PAIP 2019 is a pathology challenge on liver whole-slide images (WSIs), which is out of scope for the radiology catalog.

decisions.name: PAIP2020
decisions.reason: PAIP2020 is a pathology challenge built on whole-slide histology images of colorectal cancer for MSI classification, and pathology is out of scope.

decisions.name: pan cancer nuclei seg
decisions.reason: The TCIA page describes nucleus segmentations on H&E histopathology whole-slide images, which is pathology and therefore out of scope; it contains no radiology imaging.

decisions.name: pancreatic-cancer-ct-3d
decisions.reason: same as catalog id panorama: The README states that this Hugging Face upload is an unofficial re-upload of PANORAMA batch 1 (Zenodo 13715870), and PANORAMA is already in the catalog as 'panorama'.

decisions.name: Panoramic Dental Radiographs (OPG) Across Ages
decisions.reason: The fetched evidence is only the Kaggle page title, with no description, provenance, licence or content details, so scope and originality cannot be assessed.

decisions.name: Panoramic Dental Xray Dataset
decisions.reason: The evidence is only a page title for a personal Kaggle upload in TFRecords format, with no stated provenance, original source, licence or description, so it reads as an unofficial repackaging rather than an official dataset.

decisions.name: panorgan-pulmonology-chest-xray
decisions.reason: same as catalog id covid19-radiography: The README describes the COVID-19 Radiography Database content (COVID, Normal, Lung_Opacity, Viral Pneumonia classes; 299x299 PNG; Excel metadata sheets), so this is an unofficial personal re-upload of a dataset already in the catalog.

decisions.name: PanTrack
decisions.reason: catalog id pantrack (auto-added): Official author-hosted Hugging Face release (MIC-DKFZ authors, MICCAI 2026 paper) of 161 longitudinal pancreatic-cancer CT scans in NIfTI with instance lesion masks under CC BY-NC 4.0, not in the catalog.

decisions.name: parallax-brain-loc-data
decisions.reason: same as catalog id brain-tumor-dataset-figshare: The README says these are PNG slices and mask-derived bounding boxes re-processed from Jun Cheng's figshare brain tumor dataset (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.1512427), which is already in the catalog; the only new content is a 42-row model-generated text add-on.

decisions.name: Parkinsons-Disease-MRI-Dataset
decisions.reason: Hugging Face upload with no README, no licence and no stated provenance or official source, so it is an unverifiable personal upload whose original cannot be identified in the catalog.

decisions.name: parrot-radiology-asr-en
decisions.reason: Synthetic TTS audio paired with transcriptions of fictional radiology reports (PARROT v1.0), so it contains no medical image data at all and is out of scope.

decisions.name: PASD
decisions.reason: catalog id pasd-placenta-accreta-mri (auto-added): The Hugging Face card releases 244 de-identified T2-weighted placenta MRI volumes (NIfTI) with voxel masks and PAS labels under MIT, accompanying the authors' IEEE TIP paper, and this dataset is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: PatchChestCT: A patch-level spatial annotation dataset for nine abnormalities in chest CT
decisions.reason: catalog id patchchestct (auto-added): Scientific Data descriptor and Zenodo record 19707049 (CC BY 4.0, open) release patch-level localization labels for nine abnormalities on 2,201 CT-RATE chest CT studies, and CT-RATE is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: patient-radiology-imaging-glossary-es
decisions.reason: The dataset is a 50-term Spanish text glossary of radiology terms for patients (CSV/JSON) with no image data, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: PAVES

decisions.name: Pediatric Pneumonia Chest X-ray

decisions.name: pelviset

decisions.name: PENGWIN_Task1

decisions.name: PENGWIN_Task2
decisions.reason: same as catalog id pengwin: The candidate is a MedOtter mirror of the PENGWIN 2024 Task 2 synthetic X-ray training set (Zenodo 10913196), which belongs to the PENGWIN challenge already in the catalog as 'pengwin'.

decisions.name: PETARSeg-11K

decisions.name: PETWB-REP: A Multi-Cancer Whole-Body FDG PET/CT Dataset with Corresponding Radiology Reports
decisions.reason: catalog id petwb-rep (auto-added): The Scientific Data descriptor and the official Zenodo record 18670487 (CC BY 4.0, open) document 490 whole-body FDG PET/CT studies with paired bilingual reports, and no catalog entry covers this dataset.

decisions.reason: This is model-predicted surface output for a micro-CT scan of a Herculaneum papyrus scroll (Vesuvius Challenge), which is non-medical imaging and therefore out of scope for a radiology catalog.

decisions.name: pherc0814-afv-fibers

decisions.name: pherc0846b-lasagna
decisions.reason: This is model-predicted surface-field output derived from Vesuvius Challenge CT scans of Herculaneum papyrus scrolls, which are non-medical images and out of scope for a radiology catalog.

decisions.name: pherc1667-afv-fibers
decisions.reason: Model-generated papyrus fiber curves from a micro-CT scan of a Herculaneum scroll (Vesuvius Challenge) are non-medical, so the candidate is out of scope for a radiology catalog.

decisions.name: Pleural-Line-Segmentation-Masks

decisions.name: Pneumothorax Binary Classification task

decisions.name: Prostate Cancer MRI

decisions.name: Prostate-Anatomical-Edge-Cases

decisions.name: proton-benchmarks

decisions.name: Pulmonary Chest X-Ray Abnormalities

decisions.name: qsm-example-data

decisions.name: RadGS-Reg-Test-10

decisions.name: Radiologist Notes (Lumbar Spine)

decisions.name: radiology-hu-asr-v2

decisions.name: radiology-index-qwen3-embedding-0.6b

decisions.name: Radiology_Project

decisions.name: Radiology_Project_Annotated

decisions.name: Radiology_Test

decisions.name: RadiologyImageAnomalies

decisions.name: RadiologyMRI7

decisions.name: Radiologypublic

decisions.name: radiologytrainer

decisions.name: radiologyurldb

decisions.name: Radiomics dataset from chest CT of clinically healthy adults
decisions.reason: The title describes a radiomics feature dataset from chest CT, so it is likely tabular features without images, and the page only showed a redirect.

decisions.name: Random Sample of NIH Chest X-ray Dataset

decisions.name: RESECT-SEG

decisions.name: Shifts-2022-Part-2

decisions.name: ShortKIT-ML-data

decisions.name: Skin Lesion Images for Melanoma Classification

decisions.name: solar-flare-events

decisions.name: SOOP

decisions.name: sparse-CT-RATE

decisions.name: speall-mri

decisions.name: Spinal-Multiple-Myeloma-SEG

decisions.name: Spine Segmentation from CT Scans

decisions.name: SpineDepth_perframe

decisions.name: SpineDepth_segmented

decisions.name: SPR X-Ray Age and Gender Dataset

decisions.name: SPROUT
decisions.reason: The repository holds preprocessed histopathology nuclei segmentation datasets (MoNuSeg, CPM17, TNBC), which are pathology images and outside the catalog's radiology scope.

decisions.name: stroke-classification

decisions.reason: catalog id tcga-gbm-radiogenomics (auto-added): The official TCIA analysis-result page provides a CC BY 3.0 XLSX of ratings by three neuroradiologists, plus genomic and survival data, for 75 TCGA-GBM patients; TCGA-GBM is in the catalog but this label set is not.

decisions.name: tcga lgg mask
decisions.reason: catalog id tcga-lgg-mask (auto-added): Official TCIA analysis-result page describes 406 MATLAB ROI masks (CC BY 3.0) for 108 TCGA-LGG patients, a label set on tcga-lgg images that is not yet in the catalog (distinct from BraTS-TCGA-LGG).

decisions.name: tcga ov proteogenomics
decisions.reason: catalog id tcga-ov-proteogenomics (auto-added): Official TCIA analysis-result page provides a CC BY 3.0 CSV of adjudicated radiologist CT imaging traits, texture features and proteomic data for 20 patients of TCGA-OV, which is in the catalog; it is not radiomics-only.

decisions.name: tcga ov radiogenomics
decisions.reason: catalog id tcga-ov-radiogenomics (auto-added): The official TCIA analysis-result page provides CC BY 3.0 CSVs of multi-reader and consensus radiologist CT feature assessments for 93 TCGA-OV patients; TCGA-OV is in the catalog but this label set is not.

decisions.name: TCGA-Breast-Radiogenomics
decisions.reason: catalog id tcga-breast-radiogenomics (auto-added): The MedOtter Hugging Face mirror documents the TCIA analysis result TCGA-Breast-Radiogenomics (DOI 10.7937/K9/TCIA.2014.8SIPIY6G): tumour masks and radiologist reads for 91 TCGA-BRCA patients, a catalog collection that lacks this label set.

decisions.name: TCIA_CervicalCancer
decisions.reason: same as catalog id cc-tumor-heterogeneity: The Hugging Face card is a MedOtter re-upload of the TCIA CC-Tumor-Heterogeneity collection (DOI 10.7937/ERZ5-QZ59), which is already in the catalog as cc-tumor-heterogeneity.

decisions.name: Teeth Segmentation on dental X-ray images

decisions.name: The Chinese Mammography Database (CMMD) 2022

decisions.name: The Complete Mini-DDSM
decisions.reason: The Kaggle page returned only its title, so there is no evidence for size, format, labels or licence; Mini-DDSM (a DDSM derivative, distinct from the catalogued CBIS-DDSM) may be in scope but needs a page that loads.

decisions.name: The Duke University Cervical Spine MRI Segmentation Dataset (CSpineSeg)
decisions.reason: catalog id duke-cspineseg (auto-added): Scientific Data descriptor documents CSpineSeg, 1,255 cervical spine sagittal T2 MRI exams with vertebral body and disc segmentations on MIDRC under the MIDRC DUA; no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: The INI-32 dataset: An annotated computed tomography atlas of the orbit
decisions.reason: Data in Brief paper on an annotated orbital CT atlas appears in scope, but the evidence page only shows 'Redirecting' with no data location, size, licence or access details.

decisions.name: The IQ-OTH/NCCD lung cancer dataset
decisions.reason: The evidence contains only the Kaggle page title, with no details on provenance, format, size, labels or licence, so the core entry fields cannot be filled.

decisions.name: The PANDA challenge
decisions.reason: PANDA is a digital pathology challenge built on whole-slide images of H&E-stained prostate biopsies, and pathology is out of scope for the catalog.

decisions.name: The UNIFESP X-Ray Body Part Classification Dataset
decisions.reason: The fetched Kaggle page returned only the title, with no size, format, licence or label information, so the possibly in-scope UNIFESP X-ray body-part dataset cannot be verified or catalogued yet.

decisions.name: Thyroid Nodule Segmentation and Classification
decisions.reason: TN-SCUI2020 is a thyroid nodule ultrasound challenge, and ultrasound is out of scope; its data-use terms also restrict publication rights to the challenge only.

decisions.name: til wsi tcga
decisions.reason: TIL-WSI-TCGA consists of tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte maps derived from H&E whole-slide pathology images, so it is digital pathology and out of scope; it does not label the radiology images in the catalog.

decisions.name: TN5000-thyroid-nodule-classification
decisions.reason: Thyroid ultrasound images (a cropped re-upload of TN5000), and ultrasound is out of scope for the catalog.

decisions.name: TOM500: A Multi-Organ Annotated Orbital MRI Dataset for Thyroid Eye Disease
decisions.reason: catalog id tom500 (auto-added): The Scientific Data descriptor documents TOM500, 500 T2-weighted orbital MRI volumes in NIfTI with 9-structure segmentations, openly hosted on figshare; no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: tompei cmmd
decisions.reason: catalog id tompei-cmmd (auto-added): The official TCIA analysis-result page shows TOMPEI-CMMD as CC BY 4.0 lesion segmentations and corrected clinical labels for MLO mammograms of the catalogued CMMD collection, and no catalog entry covers it.

decisions.name: TotalBrainHealthDataset
decisions.reason: The Kaggle page returned only its title, with no description of contents, modality, provenance or licence, so scope and officiality cannot be judged.

decisions.name: TR_ABDOMEN_RAD
decisions.reason: This is an unofficial personal Hugging Face re-upload of TEKNOFEST SYZ challenge data whose original source is not in the catalog, and the README gives no details on content, size or provenance.

decisions.name: TriALS
decisions.reason: The Hugging Face record for TriALS (liver lesion segmentation on non-contrast/multi-phase CT, CC BY-NC 4.0, manually gated) has no README, so size, format, labels and provenance cannot be filled from the evidence.

decisions.name: trust-data
decisions.reason: The README describes this as FLIP mock trust data for federated-learning test environments: OMOP tables plus DICOM re-cuts of public datasets already in the catalog (MSD Spleen and Brain, PI-CAI), synthetic generated chest X-rays and pathology metadata, so it is not an original imaging dataset in sc

decisions.name: Tuberculosis (TB) Chest X-ray Database
decisions.reason: The fetched Kaggle page yielded only its title, with no size, license, label or provenance details to fill an entry, although it looks like the official Qatar University/Rahman TB CXR upload, which is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: Tuberculosis X-Ray Dataset (Synthetic)
decisions.reason: Personal Kaggle upload labelled 'Synthetic' with no provenance or image-data description in the evidence (only the page title loaded), so it reads as a toy/synthetic set rather than an official open radiology dataset.

decisions.name: TXL-PBC-corrected
decisions.reason: TXL-PBC is a light-microscopy peripheral blood smear cell detection dataset (pathology/microscopy), which is out of scope for a radiology catalog.

decisions.name: UltiMed-ASR-FR-v1
decisions.reason: The Hugging Face card describes a synthetic French medical speech (audio/text) ASR corpus with no radiology image data, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: unair-dicom-data
decisions.reason: Personal Hugging Face upload of CT slices (cyst/stone/mass/normal, apparently kidney) in parquet. It has no README text, licence, provenance, institutional source or paper, so it is a toy re-upload without verifiable origin.

decisions.name: uncertainty-followup-discipline-radiology-v01
decisions.reason: The README describes a single CSV of synthetic text scenarios (findings and report statements) for evaluating uncertainty handling, with no image data.

decisions.name: universal-lesion-segmentation
decisions.reason: The candidate is a personal Hugging Face re-upload that aggregates other groups' public lesion datasets (LiTS, KiTS21, LIDC, LNDb, WAW-TACE, MCT-LTDiag, MSD, etc.) 'exactly as downloaded from their original sources', so it is an unofficial mirror rather than a new dataset.

decisions.name: UroCell
decisions.reason: UroCell is a FIB-SEM electron microscopy dataset of urothelial cell organelles, not a radiology modality (CT/MRI/PET/X-ray), and this is a third-party re-upload.

decisions.name: US simulation & segmentation
decisions.reason: The Kaggle title 'US simulation & segmentation' indicates an ultrasound dataset, and ultrasound is out of scope for the catalog.

decisions.name: us-cases
decisions.reason: Ultrasound-only teaching cases re-uploaded from FETAL_PLANES_DB and Byra liver data; ultrasound is out of scope.

decisions.name: us-cases-nc
decisions.reason: Ultrasound-only teaching subset (20 pediatric appendicitis ultrasound cases re-uploaded from the Regensburg dataset), which is out of scope modality and an unofficial re-upload.

decisions.name: USenhance2023_Aligned
decisions.reason: The dataset consists of ultrasound image pairs derived from the USEnhance2023 challenge, and ultrasound is out of scope for the catalog.

decisions.name: VALDO
decisions.reason: catalog id valdo-2021 (auto-added): VALDO 2021 (MICCAI challenge) brain MRI training data is openly released by the organisers on Zenodo record 4520773 and is not in the catalog. The Hugging Face candidate is a MedOtter mirror, so the official challenge and Zenodo pages are used as sources.

decisions.name: vesuvius-center-lines
decisions.reason: The candidate holds center-line coordinate tables for micro-CT scans of Herculaneum papyrus scrolls (Vesuvius Challenge), which are non-medical images with no radiology data.

decisions.name: vesuvius-snapped-labels
decisions.reason: These are surface-mesh labels on micro-CT scans of carbonized Herculaneum papyrus scrolls (Vesuvius Challenge), not medical imaging data, so they are out of scope.

decisions.name: VetXRay: Comprehensive Animal Chest X-Ray Dataset
decisions.reason: The Kaggle page returned only its title, with no description of provenance, licence, size or labels for this veterinary chest X-ray set, so scope and official origin cannot be judged.

decisions.name: victre-paired
decisions.reason: same as catalog id victre: The README says this is a repackaging of the TCIA VICTRE in-silico DBT trial (its Monte-Carlo projections and FBP reconstructions, with added simulated noise and normalization), and VICTRE is already in the catalog; the code link is a placeholder and the paper is unpublished.

decisions.name: VietPET-RoI
decisions.reason: catalog id vietpet-roi (auto-added): The Hugging Face card, tied to an ACL 2026 paper, describes an openly downloadable Vietnamese whole-body PET/CT dataset (200 patients) with regional reports and 3D ROI boxes; it is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: VinBigData Chest X-ray Resized PNG (1024x1024)
decisions.reason: same as catalog id vindr-cxr: The candidate is an unofficial Kaggle user re-upload of the VinBigData chest X-ray images resized to 1024x1024 PNG, and those images are the VinDr-CXR dataset already in the catalog.

decisions.name: VinBigData Chest X-ray Resized PNG (256x256)
decisions.reason: same as catalog id vindr-cxr: The title shows this is a personal Kaggle re-upload of the VinBigData chest X-ray competition images (VinDr-CXR) resized to 256x256 PNG, and VinDr-CXR is already in the catalog.

decisions.name: VinBigData-Chest-X-ray-Prepared
decisions.reason: same as catalog id vindr-cxr: The name identifies this README-less, unlicensed personal Hugging Face upload as a prepared re-upload of the VinBigData chest X-ray competition data, i.e. VinDr-CXR, which is already catalogued.

decisions.name: visible-human-female-atlas-inputs
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nlm-visible-human-project: This is an unofficial Hugging Face re-upload of the NLM Visible Human Female cryosection and CT slices fetched from the NLM mirror, which is already catalogued as nlm-visible-human-project.

decisions.name: visible-human-male-atlas-inputs
decisions.reason: same as catalog id nlm-visible-human-project: The README says this is a personal Hugging Face snapshot of the NLM Visible Human Male cryosection and normal CT slices, fetched from the NLM mirror, so it is the same data as the catalog's NLM Visible Human Project entry.

decisions.name: ViX-Ray-QA-v3
decisions.reason: This is a personal, auto-generated Vietnamese VQA derivative of ViX-Ray (MilitaryHospital175/VNMedical_bv175), which is not in the catalog, and its README says no doctor has reviewed it and its numbers should not be used in papers. The original ViX-Ray dataset may be worth triaging separately.

decisions.name: VoDaSuRe
decisions.reason: VoDaSuRe is a laboratory micro-CT super-resolution dataset of 16 non-clinical material samples (e.g. bamboo), not medical radiology imaging, so it is out of scope.

decisions.name: Where is VALDO?
decisions.reason: The VALDO 2021 cerebral small vessel disease MRI challenge is in scope and not in the catalog, but the fetched description page gives no data size, format, access terms or licence to fill the entry.

decisions.name: X-Gaussian
decisions.reason: This is a method-specific repackaging for the X-Gaussian paper: 5 processed CT volumes from other sources (provenance deferred to the SAX-NeRF card) with simulated projections, plus non-medical FIPS scans (pine, seashell, walnut), not an original in-scope imaging dataset.

decisions.name: X-ray Bone Shadow Supression
decisions.reason: The fetched Kaggle page shows only the title, with no description, provenance, licence or size, so it cannot yet be checked whether this is an original dataset or a re-upload of data such as JSRT bone-suppression images.

decisions.name: X-ray-Miniature-Medical-Device
decisions.reason: The gated HF card describes X-ray images of miniature medical devices (microrobots) with polygon labels, but gives no image format, exact size, or anatomy, and does not say whether the real images are patient, animal or phantom data, so scope and core fields cannot be filled.

decisions.name: X-Ray-Radiology-Reports-With-Findings-Dataset
decisions.reason: The evidence shows a commercial-vendor (InfoBayAI) Hugging Face upload of fewer than 1K X-ray images with reports, with no README, no stated image source and no provenance, so it is a toy/sample set without documented origin.

decisions.name: X-Ray-Radiology-Reports-Without-Findings-Dataset
decisions.reason: Commercial vendor (InfoBayAI) sample upload of under 1K X-ray images/reports with no README, no stated provenance or source institution, so it is a sample set without verifiable origin.

decisions.name: x-ray_acl-dataset
decisions.reason: Personal Hugging Face re-upload of the Roboflow-100 'acl-x-ray' object-detection set with no original provenance or documentation, and the original is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: x-ray_bone-fracture-Dataset
decisions.reason: This is a personal Hugging Face re-upload of the Roboflow-100 bone-fracture detection set, which has no documented clinical provenance, and its original is not in the catalog.

decisions.name: xray-baggages-customs
decisions.reason: The candidate is a consolidation of security-screening X-ray scans of baggage (CLCXray, DvXray, HiXray, OPIXray, SIXray), which are non-medical images and out of scope.

decisions.name: xray-chest-cases
decisions.reason: The README describes an unofficial personal teaching subset of 192 images drawn from NIH ChestX-ray14 and the NLM TB sets, all already in the catalog, with no new labels beyond the existing NIH bounding boxes and TB readings.

decisions.name: Xray-OPG-Dental-Radiology-Reports-Without-Findings-Dataset
decisions.reason: Gated Hugging Face upload from a data vendor (InfoBayAI) with no README, no licence and no provenance, so there is too little evidence to judge whether it is an open research dataset or a commercial sample.

decisions.name: xraydar-reports
